capabilities: browse folders, tags, properties, outgoing links, and backlinks as a card stream
capture notes with quick input windows and reusable templates
save filtered folder, tag, and property views as reusable card boxes
search and filter the current folder, box, or links view with highlighted snippets
drag cards to move files, apply tags and properties, insert into the editor, or drop into Canvas and Excalidraw
disambiguation: Not a kanban board or database table; it renders existing notes as a readable stream and never moves source files out of their folders.
extras: Licensed GPL-3.0-only from 1.5.x onward; releases through 1.4.2 remain MIT. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later (older versions get release 1.3.4). Full documentation is hosted externally. Desktop quick input depends on the Obsidian frame or Hidden frame setting and drafts do not survive restarts. Mobile settings are per-device while boxes, favorites, pins, and templates live in the vault.
intentEvidence: It gives you direct controls instead of another query language.
problem: Obsidian scatters folders, tags, backlinks, and outgoing links across separate panels, and filename lists lose note content when scanning a body of work that crosses folder boundaries.

relations.evidence: install the Excalidraw plugin and enable SVG auto-export

summary: Sidebar card stream that gathers folders, tags, properties, links, and saved card boxes beside the editor, with quick capture, search, and drag-based organizing.
